newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar's Al-Rayyan field to go on stream next week.
newsitem.headline: Qatar's Al-Rayyan field to go on stream next week.

text.p: Qatar's al-Rayyan oilfield will go on stream within a few days, operator Atlantic Richfield Co (ARCO) said on Saturday.
"Al-Rayyan field will start pumping oil anytime between November 5 and 7," said Paul Fronterhouse, vice president of ARCO in Qatar.
The 35,000 barrels per day (bpd) capacity field will tip Qatar's oil output capacity to over 500,000 bpd, well above its current OPEC quota of 378,000 bpd.
Al-Rayyan, an offshore field 156 km (100 miles) north of the Qatari capital Doha, is being developed by an international consortium under a production-sharing agreement.

ARCO Qatar Inc has a 27.5 percent stake in the consortium with Gulf Stream Resources Canada Ltd (27.5 percent), British Gas Plc (25 percent) and German firms Wintershall (15 percent) and Preussag Energies (five percent).
Fronterhouse said initial production from Al-Rayyan will be 30,000 bpd, which will increase to 50,000 bpd in four years.
